title: Subject-Verb Agreement with Biology Nouns
objective: Students make verbs match singular, plural, and collective scientific subjects.
outcomes: Add -s for third-person singular present verbs.
Avoid agreement mistakes after long phrases.
Use data carefully as singular/plural depending on context.
activity: Agreement hunt: students find the subject and choose the correct verb in ten sentences.
example: “The graph shows an increase.” but “The results show an increase.”
